div.head: Leis Wl 21
div.ab: De entercement de vif aveir: kil voldra clamer pur embled e voldrad duner gwage e truver plege a parsivre sun apel, dunc estuvera celui ki l'avera entre mains numer sun guarant s'il l'ad.

The attachment of livestock: if anyone desires to claim it as stolen, and is willing to give pledge and find surety for prosecuting his claim, he who has possession of it must name his warrantor, if he has one.

note.label: cf.
note.quote: cf. also Leis Wl 21 – 21:5, Wl art. 5 on witnessing and attachment of livestock
